profile.headline: Sr. Computer Programmer | Software Development Advisor | Application Support  at Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
profile.summary:
Allen is a creative and innovative IT Professional with extensive experience in programming, developing applications, and maintaining web content and web communications. Excellent writer and communicator. 

Specialties: 

• Develop custom applications and PowerShell Scripts for automation.
• Application Support
• Create new Exchange distribution lists, contacts and mailboxes using PowerShell Scripting.
• Create automated programmatic distribution list (C#) for integration with Active Directory and Microsoft Identity Manager 2016
• Provide support to resolve problems relating to Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft Outlook, RIM Blackberry.
•  Demonstrate expert knowledge of windows server administration to include AD and LDAP and Virtual Servers
• Provide list server messaging support for administration of list server settings and lists. 
• Write programming code associated with management agents for Microsoft Lifecycle Manager. 
•  Migration of web-based applications from 2008 server to Windows Server 2012 R2
• SQL Server 2014 Management
• Develop -IoT-Application Programming-C/C++/Java
• Develop Databases-DB Development-MS SQL 
•  Messaging & Collaboration Specialist-Microsoft-Exchange Server-Exchange Server
•  Security Specialist-Identity & Access Mgmt-Federation Mgmt-Microsoft Active Directory Federation 
Systems Specialist-Active Directory-Microsoft Directory Services-Identity and authentication (Kerberos, NTLM)

positions.title: Network Administrator / Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Essential Functions
The tasks, duties, and responsibilities of this job include, but are not limited to:
➢Configure switches, access points, and IP related devices for Optimum performance.
➢Troubleshoot and repair communication lines to maintain connectivity.
➢Create network, email, and system accounts for all domain users, and assign rights/groups.
➢Work with the systems team, to ensure proper configuration and data communication.
➢Maintain the data center and all IDF wiring and configuration according to best practices.
➢Configure & maintain all Network Services such as DNS, DHCP, Group Polices, security etc.
➢Install, configure, and maintain network applications and tools for proper connectivity.
➢Ensure integration between network services, policies, and security.
➢Manage the central directory service (Active Directory) to ensure optimum user experience.
➢Manage user groups, distribution groups, and security groups.  
➢Monitor and troubleshoot network degradation, outages, and inconsistencies.
➢Work with Users to troubleshoot and resolve network related issues

volunteerExperiences.description:
Community Connections is a domestic nonprofit 501(c)3 corporation governed by a Board of Directors to ensure compliance with state law and regulations. Community Connections is licensed as a Child Placing Agency to provide foster and adoptive homes and supportive services for children who are in the temporary legal custody of DFCS in Georgia. Children served are from the ages of newborn to 18 years, and may have a range of medical, emotional, behavioral, and educational needs. Community Connections approves all prospective foster and adoptive parent applicants in accordance with the Georgia Department of Human Services, Office of Residential Child Care and Office of Provider Management rules and regulations.
www.c-connections.com

projects.title: A+ Certification Project
projects.description:
Lead students to successful completion on A+ certifications.
A+ certification is a vendor-neutral certification that certifies the competency of service professionals in the computer industry. It is for anyone who wants an internationally recognized credential as a competent computer service professional.A+ certification was specially designed for the tech support field. Technical support is the best area for a beginner to gain a good working knowledge of the basics of the IT profession. Hands-on experience gained especially in the area of problem solving is invaluable for starting an IT Career.
